capabilities: Show lunar dates, solar terms and Taiwanese festivals in month and year grids
Mark public holidays, substitute holidays and make-up workdays
Open or create the periodic note for a day, week, month, quarter or year
Add events and reminders that are written into daily note properties
Fire reminders through a dialog, corner notice or desktop notification
disambiguation: Not a calendar sync or CalDAV client; the holiday data ships inside the plugin and your entries are stored in daily note properties.
extras: Makes no network requests; the holiday table is bundled and a CI step fails the release if a network call site appears. Years without an official announcement fall back to algorithmic holidays until you paste the JSON in the settings.
problem: Obsidian calendars show plain dates, with no Taiwanese holiday table, substitute workdays, lunar dates or solar terms, and no quick way to reach the periodic note for a day.

relations.evidence: Pairs with QuickAdd to create daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly and yearly periodic notes.
Periodic notes come from either the core Daily Notes plugin or the community Periodic Notes plugin
Weekly notes are also recognised from the Calendar plugin's settings.

summary: Taiwanese almanac calendar showing public holidays, substitute workdays, lunar dates and solar terms in month and year views, plus a sidebar and floating window.
